208014.description:
After getting hit by a car, I was reincarnated into the world of "Cinderella"! I used to be a driven, hard-working person. And now, in this life, I live as Cinderella's stepsister Petra. Cinderella is a beauty, but also very lazy and sloppy. In the hopes of bringing her and the prince together in marriage just like the fairytale goes, my other sister and I did our best to educate Cinderella. People witnessing mistook our strict ways, and the rumors of "the evil stepsisters" spread around... However, despite the obstacles, we successfully saw Cinderella married off to the prince! Happily ever after!... Or so I thought until I met a mysterious gentleman named Eric. He approached me at the ball just so he could rudely accuse me of bullying Cinderella out of jealousy! Well, he chose the wrong person to pick at because this "evil stepsister" isn't going down without a fight!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

208015.description:
Gung-Mak, a clown from a traveling troupe that roamed the eight provinces of Joseon. Just as he faced a tragic and unjust death, he was reborn as a modern K-pop idol. Was it fate's cruel joke? It seems the noblewoman Lee Sun he loved also reincarnated... But Gun-Mak is now a failing idol group on the verge of disbandment, while Lee Sun is the executive investor deciding the group's fate? Skipping the afterlife, the Joseon clown Gun-Mak reincarnates as Gen-Z idol Logan.

This is the story of his timeless love and his sweet potato-eating, cider-drinking escape from a failing idol group—a tale of growth.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

208016.description:
"...My Anemone. You're so cute... I love you." Her pure body has only been held once, by him. As if she never forgot a single detail of that night, the fingertips brushing over her skin spread heat throughout her body... When he loves her sweetly with his body that's become so much more masculine in all aspects... It feels so good that they both come together...!! Anemone, who has suddenly regained her memories of her past life, realizes that she would become the villainess from a romance game that she played in the past. Set on ending her one-sided love for the Crown Prince, Michael, she begs him to embrace her. "I don't mind if it's just for the night. Would you please embrace me...?" But this one night ends up greatly changing his destiny...!? A few years later, Michael has grown to look completely different from the way he looked in the game. "I did my utmost to change for you!" he says, before asking her to become his fiancée?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

208017.description:
Lee Ye-Won, a dog beastkin, is suddenly kicked out of his college dorm and has nowhere to go despite his approaching rut cycle. That’s when cat beastkin and classmate Ji Seung-Hoo comes to the rescue. Seung-Hoo lets Ye-Won stay at his house for as long as he needs. But while this feline might seem like a savior at first, it’s really just his scheme to eat up the canine he’s been crushing on for the longest time!

(Source: Tappytoon)

208018.description:
With nothing to his name but a drop-dead gorgeous face, Kim Moran finds himself about to hit the streets after getting dumped by his lover. Enter Kwon Hosu: a rich, ridiculously attractive younger guy who confesses his undying love and offers Moran a place to stay. Expecting a sweet, easygoing dynamic with a wealthy boyfriend, Moran moves in, only to be swept up in Hosu’s overwhelming, intoxicating devotion. But beneath Hosu's adorable smile lies a side so intense, Moran can't help but wonder what secrets his boyfriend is hiding.

(Source: Lezhin US)

208019.description:
Like a butterfly drawn to a flower, I paused, captivated by its beauty. Grasping the stem, I pulled with all my strength and broke off a single blossom. Though my lips barely touched it, my whole body felt feverishly hot. It spurted hot blood without pause. It couldn't possibly be this hot otherwise.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes 24 extra chapters.

208021.description:
College student Yeonwu can’t stand Ohn, a campus senior wrapped in dark rumors...but fate keeps forcing them together. When Yeonwu rescues a vulnerable, intoxicated Ohn from a dangerous situation, their dynamic shifts overnight. Intrigued by the only guy who treats him with icy disdain, Ohn launches a relentless, seductive charm offensive. Yeon-Wu tries to resist, but Ohn’s intoxicating flirting soon has his heart racing. Can Yeon-Wu guard his heart, or will has love struck far too fast?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

208022.description:
Once the most popular guy in high school, Lim Sang-Ho never expected to be attending college at 28. At a class reunion, he reconnects with Ko Yeong-Ha, the underclassman who used to follow him everywhere - and who has somehow grown into an annoyingly-handsome adult. Bonding over their shared status as late-blooming college students, the two quickly fall back into old habits. But while feeding stray cats after the reunion, Yeong-Ha drops a bombshell: his male boss seems to have a crush on him. Completely clueless about dating men, Yeong-Ha turns to the openly gay Sang-Ho for advice…and maybe a little hands-on instruction. Some choices are hard to make. Others? Well, they’re simply the cat’s meow!

(Source: Lezhin US)

208026.description:
"I want to see your smile again" — A new girls' fantasy! A girl remembers. That this is a game world. That she had been reincarnated as a mob character. That her best friend would one day become a witch who freezes the world. And — that she would become the final boss and be destroyed. "I promise, I won't let Grace become a bad person." She refuses to accept such an ending! The girl Roselika makes her resolve and takes the hand of her best friend Grace, who has manifested the supernatural power that will turn her into a witch. She pulls her away from the family that drove her to the edge, and uses every bit of knowledge she has to defy fate. Gradually, Grace's frozen heart begins to thaw — "No matter what happens, I won't have any regrets. Because I love you, Roselika." — Being told that so directly... my heart can't help but race.

(Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)

After finding a job in a company that sells clothing all over the country, I've been assigned to a store. The manager is a really nice guy, and he's been helping me learn the ropes. I practice, I keep working, and I'm in love... with the manager even though he's already married. One day, he whispers in my ear, "I'll be waiting for you by the convenience store tonight." One thing leads to the next, and clothes come off without question. Lips on lips melt into chaos... the unfathomable abyss of love.

Arai, age 26, never had a physical relationship. In order to get a boyfriend, she suffers one disappointment after another... Stepping into a drag bar hoping to bolster her self-esteem, she just loses even more confidence by seeing all the beautiful drag queens and drinks away her sorrows. Getting tipsy, she goes on about how she's not satisfied getting off on her own, so the bartender offers Misato an unbelievable suggestion...! "Why don't I do it for you? Maybe it'll feel better if someone else touches you?" As Misato's body unravels under the kind of seductive touch of the bartender, her mind goes completely blank... "You just don't understand yourself yet."

After seven years of failing to debut here, veteran trainee Go Hye-Ri finally secures a chance through sheer effort only to have it snatched away instantly by new recruit Seo Jeong-Ha. Hye-Ri's inferiority complex explodes uncontrollably because Seo Jeong-Ha seems to have everything without effort... 208240.description:
Let's see what you've got, Mr. Popular Host.

Ryo, the third most popular host at his club, is going through a conflict with a female client of his. The gentle, softhearted nature he displays toward everyone equally has finally caused him trouble in the form of a legal complaint that might land him in court... So the club's owner brings him to Reiichi Miyashiro, a talented lawyer with an overwhelming aura, but who's cunning and impossible to deal with...! Even worse, he suddenly pushes Ryo down, saying that he's been told Ryo would be entertaining him... So now he actually has to entertain him with his body...!? Even though he hates the idea of being touched by a man, the way he licks every nook and cranny of his mouth and the way his big hands forcefully caress his shaft... make it impossible to resist...! It's a pleasure he's never experienced before, drawn out from deep inside his body, so intense that it even makes him forget how to breathe. Despite his urge to resist, he's so easily brought to climax...!

208249.description:
In a time when families born with the ability to bestow magical powers were said to enjoy peace and prosperity. Nobles flocked to purchase expensive gems and items endowed with magical powers as jewelry and talismans. Jacqueline and Ellie were sisters born with the precious ability to bestow magical powers. Ellie was born with strong magical powers, but Jacqueline, the older sister, bullied her from a young age and dominated her like a tyrant, forcing her to endow herself with excessive magical powers, thereby building her fortune. One day, Ellie began to show signs of depletion, meaning her magical powers would never return. No longer of any use, Ellie was abandoned by her sister in a tattered state. Ellie was in the depths of despair, having lost all hope of living, when a duke named Irvine gently picked her up.

(Source: Shusuisha, translated)

Jin-Ju, who suffers from domestic violence, drifts through school life due to her dependent personality. She befriends Han Si-Yeon, and the two become incredibly close through web novels. But as time passes, Si-Yeon grows weary of Jin-Ju's dependence and says hurtful things to her. That night, Jin-Ju goes missing. Afterwards, horrific rumors about Jin-Ju's disappearance spread through school, and Si-Yun is tormented by guilt. What really happened to Jin-Ju that night...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Humanity devastated by the emergence of a virus with a 100% fatality rate, People waiting for a vaccine without even knowing the infection route... Where does this catastrophe end?!!

(Source: Naver, translated)

208255.description:
Olivia Taylor opens her eyes after being caught and executed for her countless brutal murders to find that she has been reincarnated in a time and world she has no memory of called "modern-day Japan." She soon learns that the woman whose body she is inhabiting, Meisa, has been living a meager life with her preschool-age son, Reo. Meisa and Olivia's memories begin to blend together as she ends up getting caught up in a major incident involving Reo and her common-law husband, Ryuya... Surrounded by friendly faces like the loving Reo and the kind manager of the grocery store where Meisa worked, Natsuki, is this reincarnated monster now destined to navigate this new world as a mother...?! This single mom has no choice but to use the memories and instincts of her former life as a vicious serial killer to confront the evils of the present!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

208256.description:
It takes so little to become a target. Hojin only did what he had to do—help out a friend in need. He was trying to save his friend from Jung-Yoon, the school’s aggressive bully. Back then, he didn't know that doing the right thing can sometimes lead you to hell. Now the target of vicious bullying, Hojin's desperate to get back to normalcy. He’s had enough. Something inside his soul has broken. He can’t let this carry on. Small ripples of rebellion are forming inside him, and these ripples will soon turn into a tidal wave, a tidal wave that will wipe everything away.

title.native: 10回婚約破棄された私が冷徹公爵様に溺愛されるなんて罠ですか？

208335.description:
Reincarnated into a world of dual monarchies, former teacher Mito is destined to become a princess. But the school for brides-to-be becomes a gilded cage when she catches the eye of the wrong man: the Black Prince Dian. Their connection is undeniable, even as they both have their own brides-to-be. As their secret trysts intensify, the White Prince, Heal, grows suspicious-and his obsession takes a coercive turn. Caught between two powerful rulers and a destiny she never asked for, which king will Mito choose to serve?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Beloved Bride From Another World is Consumed by Her Forbidden Love
title.native: 愛され異世界花嫁は、禁断の恋に身を焦がす。
title.romaji: Aisare Isekai Hanayome wa, Kindan no Koi ni Mi wo Kogasu.

208336.description:
Kamo Kazuki was mistakenly sent to Hell. Burning in hellfire for eons, his soul became tainted, and he was forced to undergo a purification ritual in a world overrun with monsters. He became an onmyoji to speed up the purification of his soul, but because of the immense divine energy he received from King Enma, only eccentric characters gathered around him! He ended up being liked by the Yamahime, the descendant of the Great Tengu, and even the monsters he was supposed to defeat.

"King Enma, don't give me unnecessary events...!"

Accompanied by a group of eccentric companions, Kazuki's journey to defeat monsters, with his fate at stake, now begins. He returns from Hell! The unrivaled Yorozuya of the young onmyoji is now open for business!

(Source: Comic Corona, translated)

Class 4-1 is a class free of bullying and discrimination. That's because when any problem arises, class representative Makoto Saeki holds a vote during homeroom. But something feels off about this class...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

208338.description:
Welcome to the ultimate late-night confessional. Everyone keeps an intimate secret locked away, desperate for a safe place to let it out. Tonight, the bar is open, and the bartenders are ready to listen to it all. Covering everything from sweet campus flings to messy everyday dramas, this is the perfect blend of warmth, comfort, and late-night honesty. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the talk.

(Source: Lezhin US)

208341.description:
One day, a strange piece of paper with an illustration of an eye appears in Mei's shoe locker. A new paper appears with each passing day, its eye growing bigger and closer...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

208342.description:
Iori Shirase, a girl who inherited mysterious powers from her grandmother, meets Tsukasa Kuroe—a lonely girl with a natural talent for piano—and her younger brother Sousuke. As the three nurture their friendship, the shadow of the cult Tsukasa's mother joined looms closer...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: Black and White Theory of Happiness

208343.description:
The sole legitimate heir of the Hwasin Group. Jung E-Geon. He's sick of his family trying to marry him off to the girl who saved his life as a child. But his interest lies elsewhere—in Ha Yeon-Ju, the family's secret and shame. The shadow-like Ha Yeon-Ju begins to irritate him. He proposed a contract relationship to deceive his family, using her, but finds himself increasingly fixated on her...

“I suppose I was the one who wavered. Not you, Ha Yeon-Ju.”

The man, leaning on the table with his chin resting on his hand, frowned and smiled bitterly.

“So, let's date. Ha Yeon-Ju.”

(Source: Naver, translated)

208345.description:
A single grade ruined Jeong Wuyeon’s academic life, and Professor Kim Jaeshin is the man to blame. After crossing paths with a dead-drunk Jaeshin, Wuyeon seizes the opportunity to get even, crossing every line to put his teacher in his place. But behind Jaeshin’s stern exterior and divorced status lies a hidden truth that changes the entire game. Now caught in a volatile dynamic of resentment and desire, neither man can back down without risking total ruin.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: This is Not the Course Period

208346.description:
Cat shapeshifter Irene's life changes drastically the day she accidentally goes into heat on her way home from work. Luckily, she is found by the black leopard Count Nox, who takes her back to his estate. Being the only two shapeshifters in the territory, their meeting feels like fate. But with Irene's commoner background and Nox's fierce protective instincts, fitting into high society is harder than they expected. Will the two be able to overcome their troubles and find happiness and true love?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Ejaculation of a White Cat Bitten by a Black Panther

title.english: Why the White Cat Was Bitten by Count Black Leopard

title.romaji: Heukpyobeom Baekjagege Mullin Huin Goyangiui Sajeong

208347.description:
Drawing inspiration from the eerily decadent world of medieval classics, this manga radiates with the defiant spirit of the resilient common folk—the peace-loving people—who mocked the corruption and power of the ruling class at the end of the 19th century!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

208348.description:
Hailed as the Pure-White Princess, Princess Celine bears a dreadful curse. When she comes of age, her white hair will turn scarlet, and her kingdom will drown in blood. Resigned to her fate, she meaninglessly drifts through life until she meets the enigmatic yet gentle Duke Weinberg, who awakens her desire and rekindles her will to live. But as their bond deepens, so do her doubts. Who is he truly? What lies behind his love? And what will become of her kingdom that's bound to her cursed fate?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: 陰キャの甥と伯母とママと3P
title.romaji: Inkya no Oi to Oba to MAMA to 3P

208353.description:
Rose falls asleep at home and nearly faints when she wakes up at the palace in the arms of Emperor Lukewarell. Despite her uncanny resemblance to his beloved concubine, Agnes, Rose manages to convince Lukewarell that she is an ordinary tutor with no relation. However, she must help him find the missing Agnes by masquerading as the concubine and feeling out the suspicious people around her. But the more Rose learns about Agnes' complicated relationships, the less she understands who this mysterious woman was. In fact, the dread in her heart only grows as she gets closer to the truth...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

208354.description:
After school on a scorching summer day. Aki, a boy who's been bullied, resolves to confess his feelings to Yui, his childhood friend. But on the way home, Yui suddenly vanishes. They were definitely walking together. Aki, despairing at losing Yui, his only ally and the object of his affection, is overcome with grief. Then, Yui reappears before him.

“I became a shadow.”

Her form was strange. She extended limbs from within the shadows, moving as if swimming. Wherever shadows existed, she could freely enter and exit. The ground, the ceiling, even a person's body... Was she truly Yui... or something else? Aki scrambles to get Yui back. Yet, contrary to his wishes, the nightmare of the “shadow” begins to swallow them whole...

(Source: GANMA!, translated)
synonyms: Yui Can Only Live In the Shadows

208355.description:
Yeo-Ran is a wandering warrior, whose sole mission in life is to find the demon that killed her father. One night, she finds herself warped into the demon world, having to save Princess Ja-Ha from being married off to the Demon Master. There, Yeoran discovers traces of her father, bringing her one step closer to finding his killer. To find more answers and fulfill her lifelong mission, Yeo-Ran becomes Princess Ja-Ha's bodyguard. Will Yeo-Ran finally be able to find closure?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Tale of Goldiluck, the Black Kitten: Side Story

208357.description:
Sold as a slave at a young age, Lee's life is a series of cruelty and violence until he meets Asha, a maid sent to his master on an errand. Horrified by his fatal wounds, Asha uses her healing powers to save Lee and helps him flee. Touched by her warmth, Lee vows to serve and guard Asha, while she promises to protect him. But with danger lurking everywhere for this doting duo, can Lee adapt to Asha's innocent world and keep his identity a secret? Or will he ultimately endanger his sweet savior?

(Source: Tapas)

208358.description:
While out at a trendy cosplay bar with a friend, Si-Yun finds himself captivated by a striking bartender named Ara, who is sporting a pair of plush bunny ears. The night takes a chaotic turn when Si-Yun accidentally splashes a drink directly onto her headpiece. Flustered and desperate to make amends, he reaches out to help her remove the damp accessory, but as his fingers graze the fur, he freezes. The texture isn't synthetic! It’s warm, pulsing, and inexplicably real.

Noticing his shock, Ara quickly pulls Si-Yun away from the thumping music and prying eyes to a secluded corner of the bar. After a heavy, hesitant silence, she finally lets her guard down. She reveals the soft, snow-white ears that are a part of her very being, whispering a confession that defies all logic: "The truth is... I’m actually a real bunny."

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Mikake wa Chou-seiso na Haraguro Joshi ni mo Asobareru Hanashi

208364.description:
After 12 years of horrible nightmares that prevent him from getting sleep, Ujin Kim dies and wakes up to find himself in the world from his nightmares! Surrounded by demons of all kinds, he quickly realizes that he’s been reincarnated into the body of a mercenary and heads out to find civilization. He quickly learns that this is a world filled with magic, a Church fighting the demons, and all sorts of sketchy characters. But hey, at least he’s finally able to get some sleep!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: นักล่าฆ่าเพื่อรอด

208365.description:
Nam Eun-ho, a college student living alone with his younger sister, has lived a life of extreme misfortune, beginning with a childhood car accident. Eun-ho's sole goal is to live an ordinary life, remaining unnoticed. Then, one day, a campus goddess, unexpectedly entangled with him, strikes him with a sudden urge! Is this a stroke of luck, or the start of yet another misfortune?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

208368.description:
They made a vow to always be honest with each other. They were supposed to live happily ever after. But fast forward to two years later, their relationship has become strained. Kenya's attitude towards Rin has made a complete one-eighty. Day after day, Rin puts up with his derisive comments about her appearance, all because of her weight gain. When she discovers that he's even been cheating on her, it seems they've reached the point of no return. The story of a woman's journey to discover independence after facing betrayal by the man she once loved.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Don't Need This Ring Anymore: Is He Even Worth Forgiving?

208371.description:
Lady Elizaveta von Alvaheim has memories from her previous life. And that's because she remembers the details from the otome game she was hooked on. Her favorite character, The Crown Prince, His Highness Prince Klaus, is her betrothed. To complete his good ending route, she acts as the villain to the heroine, Alice Eimert. But because of her caring nature and nobility, Elizaveta ends up being adored by Alice...Will Elizaveta be able to bring Klaus happiness in the end?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I'm a Villainess in an Otome Game And Will Plot Twist The Crown Prince Into Happiness!
title.native: 乙女ゲームの当て馬悪役令嬢は、王太子殿下の幸せを願います！ コミック版
title.romaji: Otome Game no Ateuma Akuyaku Reijou wa, Outaishi Denka no Shiawase wo Negaimasu!

208372.description:
Out of the blue, Second Prince Maury breaks off his engagement with Ashley, the daughter of Duke Norman. However, this is no surprise to her; in fact, it's the golden opportunity she's been waiting for. Fed up with Maury's terrible behavior and poor character, she has been hoping to split with him for a while now. But even a worthless prince is still royalty; to protect her reputation, she must ensure all the fault for the split lies squarely on Maury's shoulders. She sets out to collect proof of his misdeeds, then lies in wait... and now that he's broken things off, she's ready to expose him for the filth he is. The real surprise comes from Crown Prince Eugene: impressed by Ashley's bold takedown, he pops a certain question out of nowhere...! It's a swift death to evil in this royal romantic comedy where karma takes no prisoners!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I'll Make Sure I Come Out Ahead in This Broken Engagement! And Then I'll Marry My Beloved Crown Prince!
title.native: 最大限こちらに有利な条件で婚約破棄させていただきますわ！そして、愛しの王太子様に嫁ぎます！

208373.description:
Is he... in heat?! In a world where humans and beasts live side by side, Sakuya enjoys life as a newlywed - until her human husband tragically dies of illness. Bullied by her mother-in-law and with nowhere to go, she finds herself contemplating a desperate act... until she catches sight of a dragon flying overhead. Shizuomi, a half-dragon priest from a nearby shrine, comes to her aid, soothing her wounded heart. But one night, her gentle guardian pulls her into his embrace...! A heartfelt love story between a grieving widow and her dashing, beastly protector!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

208374.description:
Isabella has reincarnated into the game world of "Princewell Royal Academy: Steal the Prince's Heart!" as the villainess. Although she attempts to avoid the "bad ending," it is all for naught when her Fiancé, Crown Prince Samuel, who's fallen in love with the heroine, breaks off their engagement. As if that weren't enough, she is stripped of her status and convicted of a crime she hasn't committed. Thus, she leaves her estate, hoping to lay low until things blow over, but she is abducted and sold to a high-class brothel on her way to her destination! How will she escape her horrid situation?! Take a read and find out!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

208375.description:
Leia is the daughter of the Sharon household, and is secretly in love with her servant, Thomas. However, her father, unable to bear his accruing dept, commits suicide. This causes Leia's stepmother to force her into a political marriage. Leia's husband is unexpectedly kind; but just when Leia is starting to have a positive outlook on her newlywed life, she hears an older woman breathing heavily in her husband's room...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

208376.description: Akizuki Haruto is the first male detective to take a full year of paternity leave. While he strives to master the art of raising his three-month-old son, Ren, his "trouble-magnet" sister ensures he can't stay away from the job for long. Once again, he finds himself swept up in a difficult case!

208377.description:
"I'm cheating... This isn't the person I'm planning to marry. He's my ex-boyfriend..." In one month, Miku is set to marry her fiancé, Yuma, but after deciding to live together before they officially tie the knot, she realizes that he may not be the kind person she thought he was. As his domineering attitude slowly causes her heart and mind to crumble away, she reunites with her ex-boyfriend, Chihaya, while searching for a job to support her family business. Still as gentle and dependable as he was in the past, Chihaya offers to help her find work. On one such day when Miku and Chihaya meet to discuss a job, they coincidentally witness her fiancé with another woman...! Seeing her shaken by this new revelation, Chihaya suddenly pulls her in for a hot, passionate kiss and tells her, "I would never cheat on you like him." Though she knows this is wrong, she is unable to push him away.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

208378.description:
On her wedding night, the virtuous woman Park Yeon-U suddenly lost her husband. To make matters worse, she was kidnapped by a villain and thrown into a well, only to wake up in 21st-century South Korea…?! To make matters worse, the man who rescued her, a dead ringer for her husband, proposes a fake marriage! The bold and virtuous Lady Park Yeon-U and the confirmed bachelor Kang Tae-Ha enter into a contract marriage of conflicting dreams.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

208380.description:
Liberte, the daughter most beloved by the late emperor. Everyone believed she would become the next emperor... but after the late emperor's passing, it was her younger brother who ascended the throne. Due to the scheming of the chancellor, who manipulated the new emperor, Liberte was forced to leave the imperial capital. She was ordered to marry the Grand Duke of Nord in the north. During her journey, fending off attackers targeting her dowry, Liberté safely reached the north. The northern reaches of the empire were shrouded in legend and rumor: “The war against monsters never ends,” “The cold breath of dragons freezes the land.” Though the journey to Nord alone took three months, it proved different from the legends and rumors—yet it was indeed a land of magic. There, she met the kind and genuine Grand Duke, Yuraha. He respected Liberté's feelings, stating he would postpone the marriage if she did not wish it. Unable to trust Yuraha, Liberté built walls, but he consistently treated her with the same unwavering attitude. While with him, Liberté would confront her long-forgotten past. Yes, Liberté had met Yuraha when she was a child...

(Source: Weavin, translated)

Always standing by the villainess's side, passively watching her wicked deeds, running away simply because she was afraid... Deeply disillusioned by her own weakness, Mia hears an unknown voice...

'Go back...? Could I really change if I went back...? But... if I don't even try, I'll never change for the rest of my life...!'

208437.description:
Lee Pyeong-Hwa has three things: a stunning face inherited from his famous mother, three different surnames thanks to her endless marriages, and a desperate need to survive after running away. Hiding his true secondary gender, he gets by working date-for-hire gigs as a beta. But when he accepts a request from an enigmatic client, Pyeong-Hwa finds himself face-to-face with Lee Tae-Gang, his soon-to-be stepbrother. Instantly exposed, he is dragged into a tangled web of undeniable chemistry and an unsettling, taboo connection. Bound by a secret he can no longer hide, Pyeong-Hwa is drawn deeper into a dangerous game of deception and desire. Is this ill-timed encounter a cruel twist of fate, or the beginning of an inevitable destiny?

(Source: Lezhin US)

208438.description:
Lido Etoile, the youngest son of the royal family, grew up oppressed because he was born to a concubine. One day, he is ordered to become engaged to Sheila Valley, the eldest daughter of the most powerful duke in the country, who is rumored to be a "ruthless villain." Lido is terrified of marrying a villain, but Sheila's personality is completely different from the rumors...?

Ryui Atrei is a child prodigy who skipped grades to enter a magic high school at the age of 12. His true identity is that of a reincarnated person who studied magic in a previous life. In order to save his younger brother from an incurable illness, he searches for healing magic, which is considered rare in modern times. His first clue is the "Three Wise Men," great wizards with vast knowledge. Will he be able to find these legendary figures? And will he be able to protect his brother? The boy's journey begins now.

Jeong I-Seo seemed to have it all. As the successful CEO of his own fashion brand and the sole male heir to an affluent family, his life was absolute perfection...until an unexpected, late-onset secondary gender presentation as an Omega turned everything upside down.

Desperate to endure the torturous heat threatening to destroy his composure, I-Seo swallowed his pride and turns to a discreet rental service app to hire an Alpha, only to entangle himself with Yoon Gang-Hyuk, a man whose breathtaking beauty is matched only by his ruthless, manipulative nature. What I-Seo expects to be a quick, transactional fix rapidly spirals into a dangerous power dynamic. Little does he realize that by opening his door to Gang-Hyuk, he has willingly invited a gorgeous piece of trash inside, one destined to unravel every last piece of his meticulously ordered life.

(Source: Lezhin US)

208442.description:
In a desolate, frozen wasteland gripped by an endless winter, Changjo is a survivor. Armed with boundless energy and the survival skills he’s cobbled together from old books, he keeps himself busy with scavenging and reading. His quiet, solitary life changes forever when he finds a beautiful man, Yeonhwa, collapsed and freezing to death in the snow. Putting his purely textbook "knowledge" to the test, Changjo does everything in his power to nurse Yeonhwa back to health. Can this innocent man warm the heart of a stranger in a world that has forgotten spring?

(Source: Lezhin US)

208443.description:
Dive into the vibrant world of Greek mythology! This saga will take you inside the dysfunctional pantheon of the gods navigating life, love, and everything in between—just on a slightly grander scale. Peek in on Zeus and Hera after three hundred years of marriage. What trouble will the devilishly handsome Hades find himself in? And if you thought your ex was possessive, wait until you see what Persephone’s like when she fancies someone...

(Source: Yen Press)

208444.description:
Unknown actor Ku Jaehee just struck gold. Thanks to his breakout role in the smash-hit drama Second the Best, he went from nobody to superstar overnight with a massive 30% viewership rating. Now, movie offers, high-paying commercials, and reality show invites are flooding his inbox. He’s officially the nation's newest obsession. But behind the flashing cameras and glamorous red carpets, Jaehee is hiding a chaotic, scandalous reality. What happens when the cameras stop rolling?

(Source: Lezhin US)

208445.description:
After stealing from a client in a bid to escape a dark past of debt and degradation, Yu-il seeks refuge in a distant countryside, only to fall for the enigmatic local priest, Kwon Mujin. Yu-il believes he has finally found a safe haven…until his peace shatters the night he stumbles upon the priest’s secret tryst. Caught spying and unable to hide his own arousal, Yu-il is subjected to Mujin’s sadistically lewd punishment. Stripped of his defenses, the young fugitive is forced to expose his innermost desires as if laying them bare in confession. But unbeknownst to Yu-il, the holy man conceals an ominous secret—one that threatens to drag him deep into an abyss where sanctity bleeds into a truly holy vice.

208450.description:
A mysterious girl appears in people's dreams. When she appears, the scenery turns bright red, and time stops in the dream world.

The girl speaks softly. "You must be bored, right? I'll tell you an interesting story..." Time begins to move again, and so begins this omnibus horror story where a dream world comes to life as the girl narrates.

(Source: Manga DANDAN, translated)

208451.description:
A terrifying witch lives on a hill and will eat anyone who approaches carelessly. The target of these strange rumors is a timid young man who runs a pharmacy on the outskirts of town. He lived a carefree life, away from everyone, until he suddenly became famous. The young man thought the rumors about him being a "witch" weren't so bad, until one day a girl suddenly came to visit him, asking to be his apprentice...!?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)
